title: Deepden moves to the Sinkholes
changes: Deepden, the Hide-Kin capital, now stands in the Mawdeep Sinkholes, on the back way through the Pitfields, about 15 tiles west of Hidehall. Its west gate opens toward the Pitfields, its east gate onto the back way to Hidehall and the paved highway north to the Great Maw road, and its south gate onto a dirt road round to the east gate.
Gate wardens turn away heroes under level 5, heroes at war with the Hide-Kin and heroes Wanted by them. The city's waystone keeps the same rules. The old waygate to Deepden is gone.
All five clan cities now stand in their homelands. The old city strip under the Crown is empty.
Hidehall's garrison lost its two burrow ambushers by the new city, and two patrols now turn back at Hidehall's gate.
